title: Flipkart expands Ekart capacity, adds 750+ PIN codes ahead of festive season
summary: Ekart has also added more than 750 PIN codes to its network, including locations in Leh, Kargil, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh and the Northeast. The expansion takes Ekart’s network to more than 8,200 facilities, including fulfilment centres, sortation hubs and last-mile delivery operations. Flipkart Minutes operates nearly 1,200 micro-fulfilment centres across more than 150 cities.
